**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 18 of the MSA already meets or exceeds the preferred playbook position on vendor insurance:

- **§ 18.1 (limits):** CGL USD 1M per occurrence / 2M aggregate ✓; professional E&O USD 2M ✓; cyber and privacy liability USD 5M ✓ (appropriate since Vendor processes Customer Data under §§ 15 and 17); workers' compensation as required by law ✓; plus employer's liability USD 1M as extra coverage. Term of coverage runs throughout the term and one year afterward, matching our model language.
- **§ 18.2 (mechanics):** reputable insurers, primary to our insurance where customary, certificates and evidence of coverage on request ✓, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and — importantly — "Insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities," so the Section 21 liability provisions are not indirectly capped at insurance limits.

All obligations run against Copperleaf (Vendor), so there is nothing adverse to us to redline. No fallback needed.
